title: Funscript Modifier telemetry batch
description: A batch of browser telemetry events from one document load, serialized as JSON for navigator.sendBeacon(). The environment and display describe the browser when the batch is sent.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the telemetry payload contract.

pageLoadId.description: Random UUID generated once per document load and reused for its batches. Generate a fresh ID on reload.

appVersion.description: App release or build identifier. Omit if unavailable to the startup reporter.

sentAt.description: Client time when the batch was prepared for sending.

events.description: Events in capture order. Use a separate batch when more events are pending.

timestamp.$comment: Enable date-time format assertions in the receiving validator to check calendar dates as well as the UTC representation.
timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in the format produced by JavaScript Date.toISOString().

family.description: Use other for a recognized family outside this list and unknown when the family cannot be determined.
Use other for a recognized family outside this list and unknown when the family cannot be determined.

deviceType.description: Best available device classification. Use unknown when it cannot be determined.

browserLanguage.description: Primary browser language from navigator.language, when available.

appLanguage.description: Active application UI language, when known.

majorVersion.description: Numeric major version when reliably available.

display.description: Display measurements and current app theme. Omit unavailable or out-of-range readings. Include a screen or viewport entry only when both of its dimensions are valid.

screen.description: Screen dimensions in CSS pixels from window.screen.

viewport.description: Layout viewport dimensions in CSS pixels from window.innerWidth and window.innerHeight.

devicePixelRatio.description: Reported ratio of device pixels to CSS pixels.

editorToolId.description: Stable identifier for an editor tool, independent of the localized UI label.

eventId.description: Random UUID for this event. Keep it unchanged if the same event is sent again so the receiver can deduplicate it.

startupAttemptEvent.description: Record once per document load in the JavaScript collector before loading the Blazor runtime or starting Blazor. Send promptly with the same pageLoadId used for the startup outcome.

startupSuccessEvent.description: Record once per document load after the root Blazor component completes its first interactive render. Send promptly even if this is the only event in the batch.

toolRunEvent.description: A user invokes an editor tool or starts a video, VR, or Handy action. Record once per invocation.

scriptDownloadEvent.description: The app initiates a script download in the browser.

fileName.description: Export basename suggested by the app, including the .funscript extension. Replace path separators and control characters and truncate overlong names while preserving the extension.

errorEvent.description: A failure observed by the JavaScript collector during startup or app use.

phase.description: Use startup for failures until the root Blazor component completes its first interactive render. Use runtime for failures after that point.

errorType.description: Exception type or a collector-defined error category. Use UnknownError when no type can be derived.

code.description: Stable error code assigned by the app or collector, when available.

message.description: Optional single-line diagnostic summary sanitized by the sender. Remove user data, filenames, URLs, paths, secrets, and stack frames. Omit if safe text is unavailable.

events.message: The Blazor runtime script could not be loaded.
